title: If you ever wondered how would a fully on-the-fly AI generated VR storytelling look like, here it is. Crazy project, probably not the best idea to work on, but passion is passion.
author: AdamFilandr

comments.author: formicidfighter
comments.body: Super cool! What models are you using under the hood?

replies.author: AdamFilandr
replies.body: 9 in total, mostly OpenAI, Suno, Udio, BlockadeLabs etc. - but I'm considering now moving on open source models.

comments.author: mrpressydepress
comments.body: Looks cool! Is it based on being connected to a pc in realtime?

comments.author: mrpressydepress
comments.body: Ok I tried this and loved it! There's a lot to improve if course but as a POC it's wonderful. I love some of the solutions you devised. Also loved the overall vibe. Is there any way to Improve the latency?

replies.author: AdamFilandr
replies.body: Glad you enjoyed it! The latency is unfortunately the hardest problem to solve - hopefully future models will be faster. I'm also looking for a better quality model for the backgrounds :)

comments.author: TheRealErikMalkavian
comments.body: Nice Work.  Very impressive on the fly generation.  Is there a reason you choose VR as oppose to Flat Screen Adam?
